```
46	export function placeStatueTrap(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): void {

57	      if (st.type[bi] === TRAP_162) continue;                       // tile.type != 162（冰特判）
58	      st.setTileSilent(tx, ty, TRAP, 0, 0);
59	      // WireLine(new Point(x,y), new Point(tx,ty))：横段沿雕像 y、竖段沿陷阱 x
60	      const x0 = Math.min(x, tx), x1 = Math.max(x, tx);
61	      const y0 = Math.min(y, ty), y1 = Math.max(y, ty);

63	      for (let wy = y0; wy <= y1; wy++) st.wire[st.idx(tx, wy)] |= WIRE_RED;
64	      return;
65	    }
66	  }
```

## 🤖 Assistant · 2026-08-19T06:17:16.207Z · glm-x-preview-260804

<details open>
<summary>💭 thinking</summary>

````
Found it. Vanilla PlaceTile for statues (105/349):

```cs
case 104: case 105: ... case 349: ...
    Place2xX(i, j, (ushort)num, style);
    SquareTileFrame(i, j);
    break;
```
````

```
function solidAllowBottom(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return true;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  if (!st.flags[i] || (st.wire[i] & 32)) return false;
  const d = TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]];
  if (!d || !(genSolidType(st.type[i]) || d.platform)) return false;
  const sl = st.slope[i];
  const sh = SWEEP_SHEET[st.type[i]];
  const topSlope = sl === 1 || sl === 2;
  if (topSlope && !(PLATFORMS.has(sh) && platformProperTop(st.frameX[i]!))) return false;
  return !st.half[i];
}
```

```
/** 按内部 tile id 查生成期实心值（Main.tileSolid[type] 等价）。 */
export function genSolidType(t: number): boolean {
  const o = solidOverrides.get(t);
  if (o !== undefined) return o;
  return !!TILE_DEFS[t]?.solid;
}

/** 原版 Main.tileSolid=true 而 TILE_DEFS.solid(运行时碰撞)=false 的 9 类 sheet：
 *  19 平台族(Main.cs:7842)/239/380/427/435-439(Echo 族)——vanilla-tilecollision.json
 *  对账差集（这 9 类无生成期翻转记录）。genSolidType() 兜底是 TILE_DEFS.solid
 *  （碰撞语义），凡语义上要读「生成期 Main.tileSolid」的调用方（Pots 首实心门/
 *  PlacePot 地面门、SpreadGrass 3×3 实心扫描等）须经由本包装——尾部清剿批
 *  2026-08-17。 */
const VAN_TILE_SOLID_EXTRA = new Set([19, 239, 380, 427, 435, 436, 437, 438, 439]);
const SHEET_OF_TYPE = new Int32Array(TILE_DEFS.length).fill(-1);
for (let i = 0; i < TILE_DEFS.length; i++) {
  const s = TILE_DEFS[i]?.vanilla?.sheet;
  if (typeof s === 'number') SHEET_OF_TYPE[i] = s;
}
export function vanGenSolidType(t: number): boolean {
  if (VAN_TILE_SOLID_EXTRA.has(SHEET_OF_TYPE[t] ?? -1)) return true;
  return genSolidType(t);
}

/** 生成期实心查询（供消费端替代裸 `TILE_DEFS[t]?.solid`）：
 *  active && 生成期 tileSolid。half/slope/platform 等衍生语义由调用方自行叠加
 *  （各 pass 的 SolidTile 近似口径不一,不在此处收敛）。 */
export function isGenSolid(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return false;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  if (!st.flags[i]) return false;
  return genSolidType(st.type[i]);
}
```

```
  if (ctx.destroyObject) return;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  const sheet = SWEEP_SHEET[st.type[i]];
  let num = 0, num2 = 0;
  let cx = Math.floor(st.frameX[i]! / 18);
  while (cx >= 3) { cx -= 3; num++; }

  let cy = Math.floor(st.frameY[i]! / 18);
  while (cy >= 3) { cy -= 3; num2++; }
  const y0 = y - cy;
  const fxBase = num * 54, fyBase = num2 * 54;
  let bad = false;
  for (let xx = x0; xx < x0 + 3 && !bad; xx++) {
    for (let yy = y0; yy < y0 + 3; yy++) {

}
```

```
Also — `if (nx < x0) x0 = nx; if (nx > x1) x1 = nx;` on one line — fine stylistically? `if (nx < x0) x0 = nx; if (nx > x1) x1 = nx;` — valid JS. OK.

But there's one more design flaw: backfillZeroFrames is called for every window cell (9 per attempt) — the frameX/frameY early-exit makes it cheap for non-debt cells. But for a DEBT cell it re-scans each time it appears in a window — fine (rare).

Also — the mixed-frame `return` inside grow aborts — but note the order: I check frames of neighbors BEFORE updating bbox — if a same-type active neighbor has non-zero frames → return (skip) ✓.

Fix the cx bug now.
```

</details>

```
        expect(
          !(segs[s][1] - segs[s][0] + 1 >= 5 && gap >= 1 && gap <= 6 && segs[s + 1][1] - segs[s + 1][0] + 1 <= 3),

        ).toBe(true);
      }
    }

    //    （CCCC 批 2026-08-18 16:54 交付后本种子 (3095,771) 首现）。登记表修剪在

    //    拦不住——运行期砍伐消费 world.trees 时须容忍该覆写（终局后可加管线尾
    //    type==TREE 修剪，src 侧记账勿在窗口内动）。
    const LIVING_MAHOGANY = TILE_BY_KEY['v_383_living_mahogany_block']!;
    for (const t of world.trees) {
      const top = st.type[st.idx(t.x, t.y)];
      expect(top === TREE || top === LIVING_MAHOGANY, `登记树(${t.x},${t.y})顶部缺格`).toBe(true);
    }
  }, 600000);
});
```
